policy.primary_focus: Compact / folding / straight rain umbrellas (handheld small umbrellas)
policy.secondary_focus: A small selection of beach umbrellas and parasols
policy.excluded: Beach chairs, outdoor furniture, sun shelters, cabanas, gazebos, beach tents, patio and garden shade umbrellas
policy.rule: Only slugs listed under primary or secondary are published on this site. Anything new from WooCommerce goes to needs_review_products.json instead of being published automatically.
